title: Meet UD_Czech-PDTC: A Large and Genre-Rich Treebank in Universal Dependencies
abstract: arXiv:2606.24337v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Czech has been part of Universal Dependencies since its first release in 2015. It has also been one of the best represented languages, with the Prague Dependency Treebank being order of magnitude larger than most other UD treebanks. More recently, three other datasets from the Prague family were added and the annotations thoroughly revisited, forming the "Prague Dependency Treebank-Consolidated" (PDT-C). In comparison to the original PDT, PDT-C is more than twice as large, but it is also much more diverse in terms of genres and domains. In this paper, we describe the conversion of the new resource to Universal Dependencies. translated_title: 认识UD_Czech-PDTC：一个大型且体裁丰富的通用依存树库
translated_abstract: 捷克语自2015年通用依存关系首次发布以来就一直包含在其中，并且是表现最好的语言之一，其布拉格依存树库比大多数其他UD树库大一个数量级。最近，来自布拉格系列的另外三个数据集被添加进来，且标注经过了彻底修订，形成了“布拉格依存树库-整合版”（PDT-C）。与原始PDT相比，PDT-C的规模是其两倍以上，而且在体裁和领域方面也更加多样化。在本文中，我们描述了将这一新资源转换为通用依存格式的过程。虽然这两种标注方案乍看起来相对相似，但在依存结构的拓扑结构以及词性和关系类型清单的粒度方面存在许多细微差异。我们通过示例展示了此类差异中的一部分，并讨论了产生分歧的不同动机。
tldr: 本文介绍了将规模扩大一倍以上且体裁更加多样化的布拉格依存树库整合版（PDT-C）转换为通用依存格式（UD_Czech-PDTC）的过程，并通过实例详细分析了两种标注方案在依存结构拓扑和词性、关系类型粒度上的诸多细微差异。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the conversion of the doubled-size and genre-diverse Prague Dependency Treebank-Consolidated (PDT-C) into Universal Dependencies as UD_Czech-PDTC, demonstrating numerous fine-grained differences between the two annotation schemes in dependency structure topology and POS/relation type inventories.
